titel: Pretzels: baked baking soda instead of lye
kurz: Pretzels get their colour and flavour from an alkaline bath. At home, baked baking soda does the job more gently.
bild_im_kopf: Like a primer before painting: the short dip decides how the colour turns out later.
faustregeln: Baked baking soda is an irritant: keep it away from your face and wash your hands afterwards.
Do not use an aluminium tray or bowl.
Real food-grade lye (sodium hydroxide) gives more colour but is caustic: only with gloves and safety goggles.
schritte: Make baked baking soda (see the lab recipe): 2 hours at 120 °C.
Dissolve about 150 g of it in just under 500 ml of warm water.
Dip the shaped pretzels briefly, rinse briefly and let them drain.
Sprinkle with coarse salt and bake hot.
